job.description:
Job Title: Fullstack AI Software Development Engineer (GR-T)
Experience Level: Senior (8+ years)
Employment Type: 3-month contract, extendable based on project needs | 8 hours/day
Working Hours: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST overlap required
Location: Remote (Global Delivery Model)
About the Role
We are seeking a Fullstack AI Software Development Engineer (GR-T) to design and build enterprise-grade, AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate brings deep fullstack expertise with a strong backend focus, hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks, and practical exposure to Generative AI, RAG systems, and agentic AI workflows. You will work in distributed Agile teams delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions.

Required Skills & Experience
Core Requirements
8+ years of experience as a Fullstack Software Engineer building enterprise-grade applications
Strong experience writing unit and integration tests
Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum teams within a global delivery model
Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate in a multicultural, distributed team
Hands-on experience with Git and modern version control workflows
Experience working on production systems using Python and TypeScript
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for cloud-based deployments



AI & GenAI Experience
Experience or strong familiarity with GenAI model providers such as:
Amazon Bedrock
OpenAI APIs
Databricks (or equivalent platforms)
Hands-on experience building or integrating Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions
Experience designing or working with Enterprise Agentic AI workflows



Backend Requirements (Primary Focus)
Strong experience with Python and Node.js + TypeScript
Deep understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and software design patterns
Experience using frameworks such as Next.js and Cypress
5+ years of experience writing complex SQL queries (PostgreSQL preferred)
Strong knowledge of:
Authentication & authorization (JWT, OAuth)
Error handling and data validation
Backend-first mindset with an emphasis on scalable and maintainable architectures

Frontend Requirements
Proven experience with React.js and TypeScript
Strong understanding of component-based UI architecture
Familiarity with frontend build tools such as Webpack and Babel

Nice to Have
Experience building AI-enabled enterprise platforms
Exposure to cloud-native architectures and observability tooling
Experience working with large-scale distributed systems
What We Offer
Opportunity to work on large-scale, enterprise systems
Fully remote, globally distributed team
Collaborative Agile environment
Long-term project stability and growth opportunities
